lyrics:
Have you missed a season waiting for a reason

Have you missed the rain and sunshine reeling in the past

Wrinkle on your face stinking all the place

Do remember to smile when they come trace

You are a cluster of cells and consciousness

World is a sweet spot for you to celebrate

Crawling in the dark where the day is bright and red

Whining in your suite where the street is big and loud

Please remove your rags and embrace the crowd

Coz life begins its part when you paint it wild

You are a cluster of cells and consciousness

World is a sweet spot for you to celebrate
